paper_proof_updates.scope: Unconditional compact Volterra residual invertibility, bounded bilinear kernel dependence, joint C-infinity of the inverse solution in kernel and source, and its actual Frechet derivative equation are proved. Actual MSA kernel/G-source coefficient dictionaries are smooth in the original amplitude norm; the existing constructed RDF is identified with that compact solution by its proved G-renewal equation. Actual RDF excess/moment, h and g are C-infinity in amplitudes at each fixed real r, justifying the previously totalized h derivative. Global h-tangent L2 representation/decay, tangent spectral OZ transcription, canonical tangent-factor uniqueness/amplitude recovery and general no-fold ordering remain open. No new axiom.

convergence_integration.scope: Real analytic branch, canonicity, endpoint and escape results for the exact-MSA coupling series; pure-fluid Taylor radius and exact mixed-coefficient signs.
